title: Michelle Never Stops!
description: Michelle is on her way to work, looking quite exhausted...

mainQuestExcel.title: Michelle Never Stops!

dialogs.text: Ow, my back...
Are you okay?
I was just getting ready for work, but then all of a sudden my back started hurting.
I promised Quinn I would go and help out at his fruit stand today, but I think it's best if I rest here for a while first...
But I can't just stay here and hold everything up.
Could you go and ask Quinn what he needs me to do? That will help me get prepared.
Okay.
Thank you. I should be fine after a short rest.
It's not far, surely you can make it?
Come on, is this really so much to ask? Help me out here.
My back hurts so much... I hope I'll recover after a short rest...
Where is my delivery? This is ridiculous...
What's happened?
*sigh* My fruit stall is all out of sunsettias. I ordered several batches a while ago...
But they still haven't arrived. And my customers won't wait forever.
Eury alone has come by three times already, and all she wants is <color=#00E1FFFF>three sunsettias</color>. She's been a regular customer for a long time, and now I'm afraid I might lose her!
I need to stay at the stall... If only someone could go and pick a few wild sunsettias for me.
If it's urgent, I can go.
Really? That's amazing! Thank you so much.
Michelle is on her way...
Hang on! What is Michelle doing picking fruit in her condition!?
We can help!
Oh no...
Oh no...
Whoa... This looks like really tough work.
Michelle has enough on her plate already. Let's help Quinn finish the job off ourselves.
And then let's beg him to give Michelle something that's a bit more manageable...
Hopefully Michelle won't mind us stepping in on her behalf like this.

Did you find me some <color=#00E1FFFF>sunsettias</color>?
Not yet.
There should be plenty of <color=#00E1FFFF>sunsettias</color> just outside the city. Please, I need to stay here — can you run and grab some quickly?
Did you find me some <color=#00E1FFFF>sunsettias</color>?
Not yet.
There should be plenty of <color=#00E1FFFF>sunsettias</color> just outside the city. Please, I need to stay here — can you run and grab some quickly?
Have you found me some sunsettias yet?
Got them right here.
Great. That should be enough for Miss Eury.
*sigh* But it looks like most of my customers have gone now. This isn't a one-person job, it seems.
Oh— I should give you something for your trouble. Hang on...
There is no need for gifts. But we do have a request for you.
It's about Michelle.
Michelle? You've seen her?
I should give her a less taxing job?
All I ever asked is that she watch the fruit stand for me.
Oh. Is that true?
But with no more customers, it looks like I won't even need her to do that...
Please tell her to go home and rest for me.
I'll go and chase up that delivery in a moment.

Have you spoken to Quinn?
Yes. He says you should get some rest.
There's nothing to do at Quinn's today anyway, go home and rest up.
Really... *sigh* Looks like I should find something else to do...
What? You're not going to take a sick day!? Take the chance while it's there!
Stop and feel what is happening all around you. That's Lord Barbatos' winds, still hard at work.
We are blessed by Barbatos. It is not a privilege we should take lightly — we all need to do our part.
As for your part... What have you been doing? Why are you sweating so much?
It seems that you are very busy yourself. But this is not a bad thing, for the more we toil, the more we sweat, and the more keenly we feel the winds of Barbatos.
Here, have this bottle of milk. Drink up and get back to it, for there is no shortage of work to be done in this world.
Thank you for your help. *sigh* Next time I need to get more people on board. Maybe Beatrice? Nah...
Hahaha... Well, on the bright side, at least we got some exercise...
